name: Figaro DAO
description: The commons' treasury, met through its operator account — an EOA carrying an EIP-7702 delegation to governance-controlled code; the multisig vault authorises upstream and funds per procurement. Author-of-record of the mandatory clauses (figaro-commerce, figaro-topology, figaro-assembly-provenance) and of any clause donated to the commons. Identity now; the buyer side (procurement through bonded processes) and the seller side (merchandise, co-produced data) follow on this same profile.
